The '''Corbett sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador]], [[Narrant sector/Legends|Narrant]], [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi]] and [[Dononter sector/Legends|Dononter sectors]] in the Mid Rim, and [[Bri'ahl sector/Legends|Bri'ahl]] and [[Stensen sector/Legends|Stensen sectors]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
